title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2024
part_text: 155. Criticises the establishment of the European Peace Facility (EPF) in 2020 and calls for its immediate termination; recalls that the EPF finances EU military operations as well as arms supplies, which further fuels conflicts and arms exports rather than preventing them; urges, instead of further pursuing military approaches, to address root causes of conflicts through diplomatic and peaceful conflict resolution;
